description: This file defines the SpecialOperator class within the SuiteCRM JSON API filters for version 1. It extends a base Operator class and provides methods for validating, converting, and recognizing special filter operators represented using specific string patterns. The class handles operators formatted as [[[operator]]], validating them with regex and throwing exceptions on invalid input.

classes.name: SpecialOperator
classes.description: A specialized filter operator class for handling operators formatted with triple square brackets (e.g., [[[operator]]]) for SuiteCRM's JSON API v1 filters.

methods.name: toFilterTag
methods.description: Converts an operator string into its filter tag representation by delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given operator string is valid, ensuring it is a string and delegating detailed validation to the parent class.

methods.name: isOperator
methods.description: Determines if a given string matches the special operator regex pattern, indicating it's a valid operator, or falls back to validity check.

methods.name: totalOperands
methods.description: Returns the total number of operands this operator expects; for SpecialOperator, always zero.
